segment_ranges.reason: No segment-ranges property appears in DeviceTree.v53ap.adt.

type.v: T8110 DART compatible (dart,t8110); no DART-gen3 compatible.

mailbox.reason: The ADT has no separate mailbox node or mailbox property for this ANE. The Apple H11ANEIn class indicates an IOKit interface but does not disclose its mailbox registers or Linux protocol.

encryption_evidence.v: Four DER fields (three IA5String plus one OCTET STRING), no KBAG; payload begins with ARM64 Mach-O magic cffaedfe. No decryption was performed.

personality.v: t8132exclave; IOClass H11ANEIn; IOProviderClass AppleARMIODevice; IONameMatch ane,t8132exclave; IOExclaveProxy true.

driver_family.v: T8150 is H18 by the community HWX generation table, but its ANE uses ane,t8132exclave and Apple's AppleH16ANEInterface/H11ANEIn ExclaveProxy personality. This differs from M6/T8152's iop-ane,ascwrap-v8 and AppleASCWrapV8ANE path. Neither observation establishes a Linux driver or safe runtime protocol.

hwx_generation.v: Community table: H18 / A19-A19 Pro / T8150, CPU subtype 10, ANE ISA 20 (medium evidence); not a measured target result for this particular IPSW or T8152.
